title: Coverage grid cells: a transfer with one side before its account's opening (transfer, opening), a refund given back to its line after the period start (refund, period start), a skipped pay that starts no period (skip, period start)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, of which Food 30,000 and Free to spend 50,000 (typed). An e-wallet is added on Wed 6 Jan at 5,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). Tue 5 Jan: a top-up of 5,000 from the bank to the e-wallet, the day before the e-wallet's opening, whose figure holds it. Fri 22 Jan: 12,000 of food. Mon 25 Jan: the pay is ticked; a new period. Tue 26 Jan: 2,000 of that food is refunded and given back to Food. Mon 1 Feb: 6,000 from Free to spend. Thu 25 Feb: no pay this month (unpaid leave): the pay is skipped. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the day before the e-wallet's opening

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 5,000 (opening figure of Wed 6 Jan, which holds the top-up of Tue 5 Jan) = 5,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 535,000 (bank today: 295,000 - 12,000 + 250,000 + 2,000) - 32,000 (Food left: 30,000 for the period from Mon 25 Jan + 2,000 refund given back to it) = 503,000

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 50,000 (Free to spend for the period from Mon 25 Jan: the skipped pay of 25 Feb starts no period) - 6,000 (Mon 1 Feb) = 44,000
